subject.summary: Microsoft co-founder (CEO 1975–2000), now chair of the Gates Foundation and founder of Breakthrough Energy. His official site gatesnotes.com links to his main social accounts. The generic handles (billgates, bgates, bill_gates …) are taken on hundreds of sites by unrelated users; only profiles that could be verified were scored. This demo shows a selection.
